title: ApplicationProps
summary: Router, root data and document composition for RouterApplication.

sections.title: Application context
sections.body: Pass a request-scoped router, its route table and initial root loader data. rootModule supplies the layout and root error boundary. document renders the full Layout; omit it when rendering into a container. A rootStore lets custom integrations publish root refreshes. Prefer mountApplication and renderApplication for the complete browser/server setup.
sections.code:
import type { ApplicationProps } from "@kasperrt/smolter/react";

const props: ApplicationProps = { router, routes, root: initialRoot };
